info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Banking Accounts Beneficiaries-v2-spec
info.description: This API allows users to efficiently retrieve a list of beneficiaries associated with specific banking accounts. By employing this functionality, financial institutions can enhance their customer service offerings by providing account holders with direct access to their beneficiaries. The primary resources include banking account details and corresponding beneficiary information, facilitating streamlined management and oversight. Typical consumers of this API include bank applications and user interfaces that require up-to-date beneficiary listings for personal finance management or transaction purposes.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of beneficiaries associated with an account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all beneficiaries linked to a specific account. It is designed to provide users with a quick overview of their beneficiaries, enabling better financial management and transparency.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the beneficiaries associated with the accounts. This request body may contain various filter parameters to narrow down the results based on specific criteria.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of beneficiaries.
